raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 13 (and possibly others) delivers merchant_id in a prefixed format such as 'M-0113' instead of the numeric '113'. The CAST to INTEGER fails on it. Stripping the 'M-' prefix before casting is therefore deterministic.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.88,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(regexp_replace(trim(merchant_id), '^M-', '') AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
